# sharqey_secret (Data Source)

Reads an existing Sharqey secret, decrypted locally. WARNING: the decrypted value is stored in Terraform state in plain text — prefer the ephemeral "sharqey_secret" and use this data source only for arguments that cannot take ephemeral values. In API mode (default), identify it with "group" + "slug". In local vault mode (provider's local_vault_path/local_vault_password set), identify it with "title" instead — "group" and "slug" are not used.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `group` (String) Full path of the group this secret lives in, e.g. "acme-corp/engineering". Required in API mode, forbidden in local vault mode.
- `slug` (String) Secret slug within that group (same as `sharqey ls` shows). Used in API mode; mutually exclusive with "title".
- `title` (String) Secret title, used to look it up in local vault mode instead of "slug". Must be unique within the vault.

### Read-Only

- `content_base64` (String, Sensitive) File content, base64-encoded, for secrets of type "file". Null for other types; "value" is empty for files.
- `filename` (String) Original file name, for secrets of type "file". Null for other types.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `notes` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `url` (String)
- `username` (String)
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Decrypted secret value.
